determines the FX spread, the free monthly conversion allowance and the
transfer limits.

The midpoint between the buy and sell price of a currency pair on the wholesale
market. Verta quotes conversions relative to this rate.

answers:
Based on our tariff schedule, a SWIFT transfer at Verta carries:

- **Flat fee:** EUR 15.00
- **Percentage fee:** 0.3% of the EUR equivalent of the amount transferred

So the total fee is the flat EUR 15.00 plus 0.3% of what you send, calculated in EUR equivalent.

Note that correspondent bank charges deducted along the way are outside Verta's control and are not refunded.

fragments.text:
Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.

Fee details
## How the SWIFT fee is composed
A SWIFT transfer carries a flat fee plus a percentage of the EUR equivalent of
the amount sent. Correspondent bank charges deducted en route are outside the
control of Verta and are not refunded.

Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Transfers
## Failed transfers
A transfer rejected by the beneficiary bank is returned within five business
days. Fees already charged on a returned SWIFT transfer are not refunded.

answers:
The SWIFT transfer fee at Verta is:

- **Flat fee:** EUR 15.00
- **Percentage fee:** 0.3% of the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount

For example, a SWIFT transfer of EUR 10,000 would incur: EUR 15.00 + (EUR 10,000 × 0.003) = EUR 45.00 total.

Note that correspondent bank charges deducted en route are outside Verta's control and are not refunded.
